receipt_proposal.custody: Approved server-side or equivalent protected delivery; browser localStorage is not tamper resistant. Separate public task and protected answer/criteria payloads. Do not place stage-response criteria in learner pre-attempt JSON. Existing public repo author artifacts are already exposed; review must distinguish author-exposed and unseen assessment.

acceptance_cases: HTTP Chromium at 1000×1600 and 1600×1000, keyboard and touch; all six stages advance one at a time and save distinct receipts.
Inspect browser network payload before first attempt: protected W, route, solution and boundary not delivered; H1/H2/H3 allowed only per approved stage and exposure policy.
Refresh after each stage; receipt-chain restores exact stage and immutable original, never reveals later payload early.
Change question revision under same stable task; stale receipt rejected, no silent carryover.
Blocked storage, corrupted receipt, failed save or unavailable backend fail closed; test no stage advance.
Attempt to bypass client via direct reveal request; protected endpoint rejects unauthorized stage; browser-only prototype cannot satisfy this.
Source return and keyboard focus restoration; actual trace recorded with exact commit/browser/version/viewport.
R01 reviews each target and fresh task, marks only independently supported operation and difficulty; stage receipts alone do not certify mastery.
